abstract: Migrates existing Capacitor iOS apps from CocoaPods to Swift Package Manager before CocoaPods Trunk becomes read-only (expected December 2, 2026). Covers how the CLI detects SPM, spm-migration-assistant behavior and manual Xcode steps, fresh SPM scaffolding, plugin compatibility checks, experimental.ios.spm options, Capacitor 9 optional Cordova product, verification commands, and real CLI/Xcode error strings.
triggers: Some installed Capacitor plugins are not compatible with SPM
